messages.author: 67573fb6b406e2fa
messages.subject: ifelse/if in RTMB
parts:
Dear all, I wrote a likelihood function (see code below) and when I use the MakeADFun function from the RTMB package, I got the following error: "Comparison is generally unsafe for AD types"

The comparison is done using ifelse to avoid having to do the log of zero value. Is there a way to overcome this issue?

Thanks

cBhalfnormlike <- function(parm, nXvar, nuZUvar, nvZVvar, nbZBvar, uHvar, vHvar,
  bHvar, Yvar, Xvar, S, wHvar) {
  beta <- parm[1:(nXvar)]
  delta <- parm[(nXvar + 1):(nXvar + nuZUvar)]
  phi <- parm[(nXvar + nuZUvar + 1):(nXvar + nuZUvar + nvZVvar)]
  kappa <- parm[(nXvar + nuZUvar + nvZVvar + 1):(nXvar + nuZUvar + nvZVvar + nbZBvar)]
  Wu <- crossprod(matrix(delta), t(uHvar))[1, ]
  Wv <- crossprod(matrix(phi), t(vHvar))[1, ]
  B <- exp(crossprod(matrix(kappa), t(bHvar))[1, ])
  epsilon <- Yvar - crossprod(matrix(beta), t(Xvar))[1, ]
  mustar <- (-exp(Wu) * S * epsilon)/(exp(Wu) + exp(Wv))
  sigmastar <- sqrt(exp(Wu) * exp(Wv)/(exp(Wu) + exp(Wv)))
  pnoV1 <- pnorm((B - mustar)/sigmastar)
  pnoV2 <- pnorm(-mustar/sigmastar)
  pnoRet <- ifelse(pnoV1 - pnoV2 > 1e-323, pnoV1 - pnoV2, 1e-323)
  ll <- -log(pnorm(B/exp(Wu/2)) - 1/2) - 1/2 * log(exp(Wu) + exp(Wv)) + dnorm(epsilon/sqrt(exp(Wu) +
    exp(Wv)), log = TRUE) + log(pnoRet)
  RTMB::ADREPORT(ll * wHvar)
  return(sum(ll * wHvar))
}

messages.subject: Re: ifelse/if in RTMB
parts:
It's not completely settled in RTMB how conditional expressions should be made available to the user. There are some options under ?TapeConfig, but a simpler way may be to define your own, e.g.:

max2 <- function(x,y).5*(abs(x-y)+x+y)

and then replace
